tasks.label: Build Docker Image
tasks.command: docker buildx build --ssh default --progress=plain --build-arg COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD) --build-arg BUILD_DATE=$(date -u +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') --build-arg USER_ID=$(id -u) --build-arg GROUP_ID=$(id -g) --load -t ghini-desktop:latest .
tasks.detail: Build Docker image with buildx and custom arguments

tasks.label: Build Docker Test Image
tasks.command: docker buildx build --no-cache --ssh default --progress=plain --build-arg COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD) --build-arg BUILD_DATE=$(date -u +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') --build-arg USER_ID=$(id -u) --build-arg GROUP_ID=$(id -g) --load -f Dockerfile.test -t ghini-desktop-test:latest .
tasks.detail: Build Docker test image with buildx and custom arguments

tasks.label: Stop Docker Container
tasks.command: if [ $(docker ps -q -f name=ghini_debug) ]; then docker stop ghini_debug; fi

tasks.label: Stop Docker Test Container
tasks.command: if [ $(docker ps -q -f name=ghini_test) ]; then docker stop ghini_test; fi

tasks.label: Run Docker Container
tasks.command: ( nohup docker run --rm -t -p 5678:5678 -e DEBUG=true -e USER=ghini -e DISPLAY=$DISPLAY -e DB_HOST=postgres.wysechoice.net -e DB_PORT=5432 -e DB_NAME=ghini_test3 -e DB_USER=ghini -e DB_SSLMODE=prefer -e KRB5_CONFIG=/krb5/krb5.conf -e KRB5_CLIENT_KTNAME=/krb5/krb5.keytab -e NO_AT_BRIDGE=1 -v /tmp/.X11-unix:/tmp/.X11-unix -v $HOME/krb5:/krb5:ro -v $HOME/.bauble/3.1:/home/ghini/.bauble/3.1 -v /usr/lib/dri:/usr/lib/dri  -v $HOME/debug/ghini.desktop:/app --device /dev/dri:/dev/dri --user $(id -u):$(id -g) --name ghini_debug ghini-desktop:latest &) && sleep 2

tasks.label: Run Docker Test Container
tasks.command: ( nohup docker run --rm -t -p 5678:5678 -e DEBUG=true -e USER=ghini -e DISPLAY=$DISPLAY -e DB_HOST=postgres.wysechoice.net -e DB_PORT=5432 -e DB_NAME=ghini_test3 -e DB_USER=ghini -e DB_SSLMODE=prefer -e KRB5_CONFIG=/krb5/krb5.conf -e KRB5_CLIENT_KTNAME=/krb5/krb5.keytab -e NO_AT_BRIDGE=1 -v /tmp/.X11-unix:/tmp/.X11-unix -v $HOME/krb5:/krb5:ro -v $HOME/.bauble/3.1:/home/ghini/.bauble/3.1 -v /usr/lib/dri:/usr/lib/dri  -v $HOME/debug/ghini.desktop:/app --device /dev/dri:/dev/dri --user $(id -u):$(id -g) --name ghini_test ghini-desktop-test:latest &) && sleep 2

tasks.label: Wait for Container
tasks.command: until docker exec ghini_debug netstat -tuln | grep :5678 ; do sleep 1; done

tasks.label: Wait for Test Container
tasks.command: until docker exec ghini_test netstat -tuln | grep :5678 ; do sleep 1; done
